item.title: Yours Always Festival, Featuring Benson Boone & Sombr, Has Been Canceled
item.description:
[Intro music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: "Hey music fans, we've got some disappointing news to share with you today. The Yours Always Festival, a highly anticipated music event set to take place in Salt Lake City this fall, has been canceled. The festival was scheduled to kick off on October 2nd and 3rd, but it seems that won't be happening."
[Soft background music continues to play]
Host: "According to fans who received refunds over the weekend, the festival's online presence has essentially vanished. The website is down, social media accounts are deleted, and the support email is no longer reachable. An email sent to ticket holders cited 'unforeseen circumstances' as the reason for the cancellation."
[Short pause]
Host: "The lineup was set to feature some big names, including Benson Boone, sombr, and Joshua Bassett, among others. Boone's hit song 'Beautiful Things' was one of the biggest songs of 2024, and sombr has been rising quickly in the pop scene. Fans are surely going to be disappointed by this news."
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: "We've reached out to representatives for Boone and sombr to see if they have any comment on the festival's cancellation, but so far, no word. If you were one of the ticket holders, you should have received a cancellation email by now. We'll keep an eye on this story and see if we can get any more information."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one."
